processing.lengthRule: uniform scale so the overall Z extent (muzzle / head to butt / pommel) = the plan's real length
processing.origin: the main hand (Grip) at the origin: the centred frame shifted by [-0.00193,-0.00102,0.38]

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane); y = the middle of a ray along Y through the cross-section at z (the handle axis)

Grip2.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane); y = the middle of a ray along Y through the cross-section at z (the handle axis)

Tip.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

processing.markerNotes: two-handed (stacked hands): Grip = the bottom hand against the knob, Grip2 = the top hand above it; Tip = the barrel end cap centre
